data_register.item: Upright loading condition and unchanged liquid mass
data_register.basis: The source loading condition is held fixed while free-surface geometry is compared; displacement and gravity height are not recomputed.
The textbook rectangular-surface equation is applied at initial heel; fill level and pocketing are not supplied.

data_register.item: Required operational stability margin, downflooding and complete righting-arm curve
data_register.basis: These inputs are not supplied by the public problem and cannot be inferred from positive initial metacentric height.
